As of September 2024, which deck-building card game — designed by Donald X. Vaccarino and first published by Rio Grande Games in 2008 — had accumulated a total of sixteen expansions to its base set?
questions.explanation: Dominion, widely credited with popularizing the deck-building genre, has seen remarkable longevity with sixteen expansions released as of September 2024, including sets like Seaside, Prosperity, and Empires. Designed by Donald X. Vaccarino, it won the Spiel des Jahres in 2009. Its expansive catalog of expansions is a testament to its enduring popularity in the hobby board game community.
